cohort: The study cohort consisted of patients with cardiac disease delivering a singleton infant between 24 and 41 weeks gestation, identified from the 2016-2021 National Readmissions Database.
finding: Antenatal anemia, including iron deficiency anemia, is associated with a significantly increased risk of severe maternal morbidity and mortality, as well as other adverse pregnancy outcomes, in pregnant patients with cardiac disease.
mod_finding: Antenatal anemia was associated with an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
